story_w1: Grandma Sari has an old farm in Dewdrop Valley that has been left alone too long. Time to bring it back!
story_w2: Windy Hills: bigger fields, bigger orders, and a plane ready to fly to town.
story_w3: The Salt Coast: a busy harbour town and picky buyers.
story_w4: Snowcap Peak: cold, quiet... and a visitor from outer space.
truck_empty: Tap goods in the warehouse to load them onto the truck.
tut_bear: A bear! Tap it repeatedly to cage it, then sell it.
tut_buy_animal: Buy animals from the Animals panel on the right.
tut_cat: Cats pick up goods from the ground and carry them to the warehouse.
tut_city: Missing ingredients? Buy them from town.
tut_click_meter: Every tap fills the meter. When it's full you earn coins!
tut_collect: Tap products to store them before they vanish.
tut_dog: Dogs catch bears for you. Buy one when bears keep coming.
tut_mole: A mole eats grass! Tap it repeatedly to chase it away.
tut_plane: Need sugar, yeast, coal, paint or chalk? Order it by plane, then send it.
tut_plant_grass: Hungry animal! Tap the ground to plant grass.
tut_truck: Load products on the truck and send it to town for money.
tut_upgrade: Tap the ⬆ sign on a building to level it up: faster, with a longer queue.
tut_warehouse: The warehouse has limited room. Tap it to see what's inside.
tut_well: The well is empty. Tap it to refill.
tut_workshop: Build a workshop on an empty slot to process products.
warehouse_empty: The warehouse is empty. Collect goods from the field.
